High Society - Downtown Murfreesboro Music Venue

High Society is an upscale bar and grill located at 211 W Main Street in historic downtown Murfreesboro. Founded in 2025 this locally and family-owned establishment features Cajun-Asian fusion cuisine combining Louisiana Cajun flavors with Asian cooking techniques.

Music Programming

The venue hosts a beloved Wednesday night Jam Session tradition that brings together musicians vocalists and music lovers. The lounge transforms into a live music playground where performers from all skill levels come to connect and create. Whether its blues country rock R&B or something unexpected all genres thrive here with variety and authenticity.

Atmosphere

High Society provides a high-energy downtown venue with extended hours and VIP lounge options. The space is versatile and suitable for private events special occasions and live performances. They also feature live musician performances featured acts and karaoke nights creating a vibrant nightlife destination.

Amenities

Full bar with specialty drinks craft cocktails and mocktails. Southern-inspired menu with seafood dishes Asian-infused cuisine and country favorites. Spacious indoor and outdoor seating options available.
